pattern: Bash working directory resets between calls, so relative paths fail
evidence: node script wrote to ../lockup/ after cd into svg/ -> ENOENT; harness printed 'Shell cwd was reset to /home/user/BETA-ART' after every cd
proposal: CLAUDE.md line: use absolute paths in Bash

pattern: Chromium screenshots clip or blank out when the HTML wrapper constrains body height
evidence: lockup PNG cut mid-glyph at 'CARE' (proof2 render); same clip after switching to explicit width/height attributes (t2.png); blank 1860-byte PNG with --force-device-scale-factor=4 (t1.png); root cause corrected: it is not body height — a window sized exactly to the drawing clips it (800x320 drawing in an 800x320 window loses everything below y=235; same drawing in 800x400 is complete)
proposal: scripts/svg-to-png.sh — renders with 35% viewport slack; verified on the lockup that kept clipping
note: scripts/svg-to-png.sh; first attempt failed its own test, which is how the real cause was found

pattern: SendUserFile rejects very tall full-page screenshots with HTTP 400
evidence: final-mobile.png 1.3 MiB full-page -> 400; re-encoded as 0.4 MiB JPEG, still 400; 100 KB viewport-sized PNG succeeded -> height is the limit, not bytes
proposal: CLAUDE.md line: send viewport-sized crops, not full-page mobile captures

pattern: Container egress blocks non-allowlisted hosts, so deployments cannot be verified with curl
evidence: curl naviar-care.vercel.app -> 403 CONNECT; verified via Vercel web_fetch tool instead; omniroute upstreams felo.ai and opencode.ai both 403 CONNECT, making the router untestable here
proposal: CLAUDE.md line: verify deploys through the provider API, not curl

pattern: node -e with positional args writes to the wrong path when argv index is off by one
evidence: process.argv[2] was 'x', so gen2.js wrote a stray file named x into the repo; second run wrote a file named 'dummy'; both had to be removed before commit
proposal: prefer a script file with explicit named flags over node -e positionals

pattern: Brand work started without reading the live product's design tokens first
evidence: identity study picked teal #0E4F52 + Manrope; the shipped site was already forest #014933 + DM Sans, sharing only Fraunces — found only when the two were finally compared
proposal: CLAUDE.md line: before any brand work, fetch the live site's CSS custom properties and treat them as the source of truth
